column3: Body (HTML)

This classic cinematic masterpiece captures a sweeping romance filled with elegant dialogue and heartfelt performances. The stunning visual presentation and emotional storytelling make it an essential addition for any collector of timeless Hollywood dramas. Enjoy a sophisticated viewing experience that explores the enduring power of love and destiny.

This expressive graphic piece features a bold, artistic design that explores the complexity of human emotion and connection. Crafted with premium materials for lasting comfort, it serves as a meaningful conversation starter and a unique addition to any contemporary wardrobe. High-quality printing ensures the vibrant imagery remains sharp and impactful through every wear.

This fascinating historical volume provides a detailed investigation into the final days of the Third Reich and the mysterious circumstances surrounding its leader's demise. It features rare archival documentation and eyewitness accounts that offer a profound look into one of the twentieth century's most significant historical events. Perfect for collectors and history enthusiasts, this book serves as an essential resource for understanding the end of the conflict in Europe.

This premium vintage arcade cabinet features a high-resolution display and responsive controls housed in a classic stand-up silhouette. Its durable construction and vibrant side art make it an ideal centerpiece for any home game room or commercial lounge. This authentic unit offers a nostalgic gaming experience with modern reliability for collectors and enthusiasts alike.

This classic coming-of-age drama follows a group of teenagers navigating social divides and personal loyalty in 1960s Oklahoma. The film features an iconic ensemble cast of future stars delivering powerful performances in a beautifully shot adaptation of the beloved novel. It serves as a timeless cinematic staple for collectors who appreciate poignant storytelling and vintage aesthetics.

This original clamshell release offers a gritty look into the criminal underworld through a rare vintage cinematic lens. A must-have for collectors of retro thrillers, the tape delivers an authentic physical media experience characteristic of high-stakes eighties and nineties dramas. The distinctive artwork and historical format provide a nostalgic edge for any enthusiast of classic home video history.

This gripping psychological thriller explores the dark secrets and hidden motivations that test the bonds of trust between its complex characters. Readers will be captivated by the suspenseful narrative and unexpected plot twists that keep the tension high until the final page. It is a compelling choice for fans of intense mysteries who enjoy diving into the depths of human deception.

Step back into the golden era of cinema with this vintage release of the iconic suspense film. This physical media collectible features the complete theatrical drama housed in its original commemorative packaging, making it a perfect addition for enthusiasts of classic disaster movies and retro film history.

This vintage videocassette brings a critically acclaimed colonial drama to your home collection in its original physical format. The clamshell case features classic cover art, making it a nostalgic choice for cinema enthusiasts and collectors of period pieces. It offers a tactile and authentic viewing experience for those who appreciate the unique aesthetic of analog media.

This versatile casual top features a classic crew neckline and a relaxed fit for effortless everyday wear. The minimalist design and neutral tone make it an essential layering piece that pairs easily with denim or trousers. Its lightweight, breathable fabric ensures all-day comfort while maintaining a clean and modern silhouette.

This sophisticated fragrance captures a sense of mystery with its blend of deep woody base notes and lighter aromatic top notes. The minimalist glass bottle design adds a touch of modern elegance to any vanity or collection. It is the perfect choice for evening wear or special occasions when you want to leave a lasting, enigmatic impression.

This classic crime thriller features a unique blend of dark comedy and intense action, making it a standout addition to any fan's physical media collection. Housed in its original clamshell case, this vintage cassette offers a nostalgic viewing experience of a cult favorite 1990s film. Experience the gritty atmosphere and sharp performances that have made this sleek neo-noir a sought-after title for retro movie enthusiasts.

This vintage home video release captures a classic era of cinema history, presented in its original physical format collectibles fans adore. The protective sleeve features striking retro artwork, making it a standout addition to any curated library of suspenseful thrillers. Ideal for analog enthusiasts, this tape offers an authentic viewing experience that modern digital versions cannot replicate.

This classic comedy from the early eighties follows an unlucky air traffic controller who gains telekinetic powers after a freak encounter with nuclear waste. It offers a nostalgic blend of physical humor and supernatural satire that makes it a must-have for fans of vintage cinema. This physical media release allows you to revisit a unique era of high-concept humor with a definitive comedic performance.

This charming plush pair features soft, textured fur and expressive faces that bring a touch of whimsy to any collection. Their compact size makes them perfect for shelf display or as comforting companions for all ages. Crafted with high-quality materials, these delightful characters offer a heartwarming aesthetic and lasting durability.

This high-octane action film delivers intense martial arts choreography and gripping tactical combat sequences. It is an essential addition for collectors of vintage genre cinema looking for a thrilling performance from a renowned screen fighter. The narrative follows a skilled operative on a dangerous rescue mission, offering non-stop excitement for fans of classic military adventure.

This essential medical accessory features a transparent barrier with a one-way valve to provide optimal protection during emergency resuscitation. The lightweight, compact design allows it to fit easily into any first aid kit or keychain for immediate accessibility. It is an indispensable tool for certified professionals and safety-conscious individuals who want to be prepared for life-saving situations.

This sophisticated fragrance features a delicate blend of floral and musk notes, creating an alluring and mysterious scent profile. Its versatile composition makes it ideal for both day and night wear, leaving a subtle yet memorable impression. This perfume is the perfect addition to any collection for those who appreciate a unique and captivating aroma.

Capture a piece of cinematic history with this highly detailed collectible figure featuring the protagonist seated on his iconic park bench with a box of chocolates. The meticulously crafted outfit and expressive features make it a standout display piece for any film enthusiast or memorabilia collector. Lightweight yet durable, this figurine serves as a poignant reminder of one of the most heartwarming stories in modern cinema.

This premium coffee table book captures the rugged spirit of urban horseback riding through striking black and white photography and intimate storytelling. Its high-quality printing and minimalist aesthetic make it a sophisticated addition to any modern interior or photography collection. This evocative volume offers a unique glimpse into a hidden subculture that blends tradition with contemporary city life.

This heartwarming picture book offers a gentle and imaginative exploration of a couple's journey toward starting a family. With its soothing narrative and whimsical illustrations, it serves as a comforting bedtime read for parents-to-be who are navigating the hopes and dreams of future parenthood. The story provides a relatable and touchingly optimistic perspective on the anticipation and love involved in waiting for a new arrival.

This high-pigment eyeshadow palette features a curated selection of matte and shimmer shades designed for effortless blending and long-lasting wear. The compact, travel-friendly design makes it perfect for creating both subtle daytime looks and dramatic evening finishes. Its versatile formula ensures a smooth application with minimal fallout for a professional, polished appearance.

This classic performance cap features a structured six-panel design and a moisture-wicking sweatband to ensure maximum comfort during high-intensity sports. The breathable side panels and adjustable closure provide a tailored fit that transitions effortlessly from the field to casual everyday wear. It is a versatile accessory built for athletes who demand both durability and a clean, athletic aesthetic.

This vintage VHS tape captures the iconic 1980s workout program designed to help users achieve a lean and toned physique through a comprehensive aerobic routine. The instructional video features a high-energy mix of floor exercises and cardiovascular movements perfect for enthusiasts of classic home fitness media. It serves as both a nostalgic collector's item and a functional guide for those looking to spice up their exercise regimen with retro flair.

This classic live-action survival film follows a young cabin boy stranded on a tropical island while evading a ruthless band of pirates. Filled with high-seas adventure and stunning scenery, it makes an excellent addition to any family movie collection for those who enjoy legendary swashbuckling tales. The story captures a timeless sense of wonder and bravery that viewers of all ages will appreciate.

This atmospheric indie adventure blends minimalist aesthetics with deep psychological themes to create a compelling narrative experience. Players explore surreal landscapes and engage in poignant dialogue that explores the complexity of human connections and isolation. It is a must-have for fans of artistic storytelling who appreciate unique visual styles and thought-provoking gameplay.

This special edition thriller follows a forensic expert and a rookie officer as they track a serial killer through a gritty urban landscape. The set features enhanced picture quality and exclusive bonus content including behind-the-scenes documentaries and director commentary. It is a must-have for fans of suspenseful crime dramas looking for a high-definition home cinema experience.

Explore the vibrant hidden gems and local culture of one of the world's most dynamic urban landscapes through this immersive travel guide. It features curated recommendations for authentic dining, art, and historical sites that go beyond the typical tourist path. This essential companion is perfect for adventurous travelers looking to experience the true essence and secret spots of the metropolis.

This gripping crime novel offers a dark and immersive look into the psychological landscape of a professional assassin navigating a dangerous underworld. Readers will find themselves captivated by the gritty narrative style and high-stakes tension that define this suspenseful thriller. It is an essential addition for fans of hard-boiled noir seeking a fast-paced and atmospheric story.

This classic black and white cinematic masterpiece comes presented on a high-quality digital format featuring a restored transfer for optimal viewing. The atmospheric legal drama offers a haunting exploration of bureaucracy and paranoia that makes it a must-have for collectors of avant-garde and philosophical filmmaking. This edition provides a definitive way to experience one of the most visually striking adaptations in film history.

This sleek piece captures a dark, alternative aesthetic through intricate hardware detailing and a structured silhouette. Crafted for durability and style, it offers a versatile look that pairs effortlessly with street-inspired wardrobes. The bold design serves as an edgy statement accessory for anyone looking to elevate their everyday ensemble.

This gripping young adult mystery follows a group of friends entangled in a web of lies and hidden motives following a tragic accident. The suspenseful narrative keeps readers guessing with its fast-paced plot and complex character dynamics. It is an ideal pick for fans of psychological thrillers looking for a story filled with tension and unexpected twists.

This engaging board game challenges players with strategic decision-making and high-stakes social deduction elements. It features a unique blend of tension and collaborative play, making it a perfect addition to any group game night or social gathering. Participants must use quick thinking to navigate complex scenarios and secure their victory before time runs out.

The touching story of a sailor (Derek Luke) who, prone to violent outbursts, is sent to a naval psychiatrist (Denzel Washington) for help. Refusing at first to open up, the young man eventually breaks down and reveals a horrific childhood. Through the guidance of his new doctor, he confronts his painful past and begins a quest to find the family he never knew.

column2: Pirates of the Caribbean, the Curse of the Black Pearl
column3: Capt. Jack Sparrow (Johnny Depp) arrives at Port Royal in the Caribbean without a ship or crew. His timing is inopportune, however, because later that evening the town is besieged by a pirate ship. The pirates kidnap the governor's daughter, Elizabeth (Keira Knightley), who's in possession of a valuable coin that is linked to a curse that has transformed the pirates into the undead. A gallant blacksmith (Orlando Bloom) in love with Elizabeth allies with Sparrow in pursuit of the pirates.

During the presidential election of 1988, a teenager named Donnie Darko sleepwalks out of his house one night and sees a giant, demonic-looking rabbit named Frank, who tells him the world will end in 28 days. When Donnie returns home, he finds that a jet engine has crashed into his bedroom. Is Donnie living in a parallel universe, is he suffering from mental illness - or will the world really end?

Paul Aufiero, a parking-garage employee, is a huge fan of the New York Giants. He lives at home with his mother and spends much of his free time extolling the virtues of his favorite football team on sports radio. One night, Paul and his best friend, Sal, spy Giants linebacker Quantrell Bishop in their neighborhood and follow him to a strip club. Paul decides to approach his idol, but the encounter goes very badly.

Alex the lion is the king of the urban jungle, the main attraction at New York's Central Park Zoo. He and his best friends -- Marty the zebra, Melman the giraffe and Gloria the hippo -- have spent their whole lives in blissful captivity before an admiring public and with regular meals provided for them. Not content to leave well enough alone, Marty lets his curiosity get the better of him and makes his escape -- with the help of some prodigious penguins -- to explore the world.

Photographer Adam Stanheight (Leigh Whannell) and oncologist Lawrence Gordon (Cary Elwes) regain consciousness while chained to pipes at either end of a filthy bathroom. As the two men realize they've been trapped by a sadistic serial killer nicknamed "Jigsaw" and must complete his perverse puzzle to live, flashbacks relate the fates of his previous victims. Meanwhile, Dr. Gordon's wife (Monica Potter) and young daughter (Makenzie Vega) are forced to watch his torture via closed-circuit video.

In the 1900s Vienna, mesmeric entertainer Eisenheim's magical abilities are wowing the crowds, with an act that ranges from mere tricks to an apparent capacity to raise the dead. However, he has also long been in love with Duchess Sophie von Teschen, which puts him in dangerous competition with the violent, scheming Crown Prince Leopold, who jumps at the opportunity to have the magician arrested on grounds of necromancy.

A fictional work that reconstructs the unknown fate of the Marquis de Sade, the writer and sexual deviant who was imprisoned in an insane asylum for the last 10 years of his life. The Marquis de Sade befriends the director of the asylum and shares affections with the asylum laundress. When a doctor is sent in to cure the Marquis of his supposed madness, the Marquis's rebellious character only grows stronger.

A dark-haired woman (Laura Elena Harring) is left amnesiac after a car crash. She wanders the streets of Los Angeles in a daze before taking refuge in an apartment. There she is discovered by Betty (Naomi Watts), a wholesome Midwestern blonde who has come to the City of Angels seeking fame as an actress. Together, the two attempt to solve the mystery of Rita's true identity. The story is set in a dream-like Los Angeles, spoilt neither by traffic jams nor smog.

Hayley is a precocious teenager who goes to a coffee shop to meet Jeff, the photographer she met on the internet. Jeff thinks he is in for a real treat, but Hayley plays a trick on him. After drugging Jeff and tying him down, Hayley reveals that she knows Jeff preys on teenage girls, and she has a plan to wring a confession from him.

When 9-year-old Damian finds a bag of money in his backyard, he and his brother Anthony decide to try to spend it without telling their father. Seeking advice from the imaginary saints with whom he converses, Damian struggles with his own morality, and attempts to spend his money in a more altruistic way. News of the mysterious loot inevitably attracts attention, however, and Damian is faced with an increasingly hairy situation.

Champion City already has a superhero, the appropriately named Captain Amazing (Greg Kinnear), but that doesn't deter the city's seven quirky amateur crime-fighters, who use the Captain's capture at the hands of villain Casanova Frankenstein (Geoffrey Rush) as motivation to prove themselves. The only problem is that their strange powers -- silverware hurling, bowling, shovel skills, incompetent invisibility and deadly flatulence -- aren't doing them any favors.

Nick (Michael Cera) cannot stop obsessing over his ex-girlfriend, Tris (Alexis Dziena), until Tris' friend Norah (Kat Dennings) suddenly shows interest in him at a club. Thus beings an odd night filled with ups and downs as the two keep running into Tris and her new boyfriend while searching for Norah's drunken friend, Caroline (Ari Graynor), with help from Nick's band mates. As the night winds down, the two have to figure out what they want from each other.

Jessica (Jennifer Westfeldt) is at the end of her emotional rope. She happens upon an intriguing personal ad, whose only drawback is that it's in the "women seeking women" section. On a daring whim, she decides to answer it. She meets funky downtown hipster Helen Cooper (Heather Juergensen) for drinks, and to her surprise, they click instantly. With conventional gender roles absent, the two women proceed to muddle through an earnest but hilarious courtship, making up the rules as they go.

Shy San Francisco teenager Mia Thermopolis (Anne Hathaway) is thrown for a loop when, from out of the blue, she learns the astonishing news that she's a real-life princess! As the heir apparent to the crown of the small European principality of Genovia, Mia begins a comical journey toward the throne when her strict and formidable grandmother, Queen Clarisse Renaldi (Julie Andrews), shows up to give her "princess lessons."

A tale of terror when a group of asbestos removal workers start work in an abandoned insane asylum. The complex of buildings looms up out of the woods like a dormant beast. Grand, imposing ... abandoned, deteriorating. The residents of Danvers, Massachusetts steer well clear of the place. But Danvers State Mental Hospital, closed down for 15 years, is about to receive five new visitors...

In 2005, average in every way private Joe Bowers (Luke Wilson) is selected to take part in a secret military experiment to put him in hibernation for a year along with a woman named Rita (Maya Rudolph). The slumbering duo is forgotten when the base they are stored on is closed down and are left in stasis until 2505. When they finally wake up, they discover the average intelligence of humans has decreased so much that Joe is now the smartest man in the world.

In this comedic documentary, Johnny Knoxville heads a crew of stuntmen, skateboarders and all-around lunatics as they prank, embarrass and torture each other in the name of fun. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly.

Survivors of Earth's second ice age live out their days on a luxury train that ploughs through snow and ice. The train's poorest residents, who live in the squalid caboose, plan to improve their lot by taking over the engine room.

When they arrive at college, socially inept freshmen Larry (Thomas Hulce) and Kent (Stephen Furst) attempt to pledge the snooty Omega Theta Pi House, but are summarily rejected. Lowering their standards, they try at the notoriously rowdy Delta Tau Chi House, and get in. The trouble is, the college dean (John Vernon) has it in for the Deltas. He has put them on "Double Secret Probation" and secretly assigned Omega's president (James Daughton) the task of having their charter revoked.

When Ben Wrightman (Jimmy Fallon), a young teacher, begins dating pretty businesswoman Lindsey Meeks (Drew Barrymore), the two don't seem to have a lot of the same interests, but they fall in love, regardless. Their romance goes well until baseball season begins, and Lindsey soon realizes that Ben is completely obsessed with the Boston Red Sox. Though she tries to understand Ben's passionate team loyalty, eventually it threatens to end their otherwise happy relationship.

Two days before his wedding, Doug (Justin Bartha) and three friends (Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis) drive to Las Vegas for a wild and memorable stag party. In fact, when the three groomsmen wake up the next morning, they can't remember a thing; nor can they find Doug. With little time to spare, the three hazy pals try to re-trace their steps and find Doug so they can get him back to Los Angeles in time to walk down the aisle.

Filmmaker Nicky (Jesse Bradford) offers to track down the son that Mamie (Lisa Kudrow) gave up for adoption nearly two decades before. Meanwhile, Mamie's stepbrother (and the father of her child), Charley (Steve Coogan), along with his boyfriend, Gil, try to find out what became of the sperm Gil donated to a lesbian couple. Finally, singer Jude (Maggie Gyllenhaal) becomes entangled in a love triangle with androgynous drummer Otis (Jason Ritter) and his conservative father (Tom Arnold).

Jeff "The Dude" Lebowski is mistaken for Jeffrey Lebowski, who is The Big Lebowski, which explains why he's roughed up and has his precious rug peed on. In search of recompense, The Dude tracks down his namesake, who offers him a job. His wife has been kidnapped and he needs a reliable bagman. Aided and hindered by his pals Walter Sobchak, a Vietnam vet, and Donny, master of stupidity.

Factory worker Trevor Reznik (Christian Bale) suffers from insomnia so severe that his condition has taken its toll on his weight and his mental health. When Trevor unintentionally causes an on-the-job accident that horribly injures a coworker (Michael Ironside), he begins to become even more troubled. Despite a relationship with Stevie (Jennifer Jason Leigh), a pretty prostitute, Trevor descends further into paranoia, blaming his problems on an enigmatic figure named Ivan (John Sharian).

Max is a reclusive mathematician who's built a super-computer that will not only provide him with the key to cracking the stock market, but may also reveal the true name of Jehovah; a discovery that could lead to the end of the world. His search however brings him to the attention of both Hassidic priests and Wall Street gurus.

The life of 11-year-old Billy Elliot, a coal miner's son in Northern England, is forever changed one day when he stumbles upon a ballet class during his weekly boxing lesson. Before long, he finds himself in dance, demonstrating the kind of raw talent seldom seen by the class' exacting instructor, Mrs. Wilkinson. With a tart tongue and a never-ending stream of cigarettes in her hand, Mrs. Wilkinson's zest for teaching is revived when she sees Billy's potential.

College student Evan Treborn (Ashton Kutcher) is afflicted with headaches so painful that he frequently blacks out. While unconscious, Evan is able to travel back in time to difficult moments in his childhood. He can also alter the past for friends, like Kayleigh (Amy Smart), who was molested by her father (Eric Stoltz). But changing the past can drastically alter the present, and Evan finds himself in nightmarish alternate realities, including one where he's locked away in prison.

Strange things are afoot in the depths of the sea. First a passenger plane vanishes over the Pacific Ocean. Then an oil platform is obliterated. Marine biologist Emma MacNeil is dispatched to investigate the phenomena, and, with the help of Japanese scientist Seiji Shimada, she makes a discovery that will rock the world: An enormous prehistoric shark and a giant octopus have been awakened from their icy slumbers -- and they're hungry.

Corporate drone Peter Gibbons hates his soul-killing job at software company Initech. While undergoing hypnotherapy, Peter is left in a blissful state when his therapist dies in the middle of their session. He refuses to work overtime, plays games at his desk and unintentionally charms two consultants into putting him on the management fast-track. When Peter's friends learn they're about to be downsized, they hatch a revenge plot against the company inspired by "Superman III."

Dave Stutler is just an average guy, but the wizard Balthazar Blake sees in him a hidden talent for sorcery. He becomes Balthazar's reluctant protégé, getting a crash course in the art of magic. As Dave prepares to help his mentor defend Manhattan from a powerful adversary, he wonders if he can survive the training, save the city and find his true love.

In this quartet of neo-noir tales, a mysterious salesman (Josh Hartnett) narrates a tragic story of co-dependency, while a musclebound vigilante (Mickey Rourke) tears his way through the criminal underworld in search of his lost love (Jaime King). In another part of the city, a grizzled cop (Bruce Willis) foils the ambitions of a child-killer (Nick Stahl), and an ex-prostitute (Brittany Murphy) evades her ex-pimp (Benicio del Toro) with the help of her new boyfriend, Dwight (Clive Owen).

It's 1933 and as the Great Depression grips America, the exploits of Tommy Gun-toting outlaws have gripped the nation's imagination. Dubbed `Public Enemies' by crusading FBI director J Edgar Hoover, the bank-robbing rogues have become Robin Hood figures to the impoverished members of the population. Public enemy number one is none other than John Dillinger, an inveterate heist expert.

A year after a severe emotional trauma, Sarah (Shauna Macdonald) goes to North Carolina to spend some time exploring caves with her friends; after descending underground, the women find strange cave paintings and evidence of an earlier expedition, then learn they are not alone: Underground predators inhabit the crevasses, and they have a taste for human flesh.

After saving a newborn infant from assassins, carrot-crunching gunman Mr. Smith (Clive Owen) teams up with a prostitute named DQ (Monica Bellucci) to protect the baby from further attacks. With hit man Hertz (Paul Giamatti) hot on their trail, Smith and DQ uncover a dying senator's plot to harvest bone marrow from babies just like the one in their arms.

Larry Gopnik (Michael Stuhlbarg) is a physics professor at a 1960s university, but his life is coming apart at the seams. His wife (Sari Lennick) is leaving him, his jobless brother (Richard Kind) has moved in, and someone is trying to sabotage his chances for tenure. Larry seeks advice from three different rabbis, but whether anyone can help him overcome his many afflictions remains to be seen.

Best friends Josh (Derek Richardson) and Paxton (Jay Hernandez) decide to spend the summer after college graduation on an all-out backpacking trip across Europe. While stopping in Amsterdam to indulge their tastes for drugs and sex, they meet Oli (Eythor Gudjonsson), a like-minded traveler from Iceland. When the three bachelors set off to investigate enticing rumors of a Slovakian hostel in a city populated by lusty women, they find themselves drawn unwittingly into a deadly game.

Freedom fighters Neo (Keanu Reeves), Trinity (Carrie-Anne Moss) and Morpheus (Laurence Fishburne) continue to lead the revolt against the Machine Army, unleashing their arsenal of extraordinary skills and weaponry against the systematic forces of repression and exploitation. In their quest to save the human race from extinction, they gain greater insight into the construct of The Matrix and Neo's pivotal role in the fate of mankind.

Electronics store stock boy Andy Stitzer is horrified when he is found out as a virgin by his workmates - just when he thought he was becoming one of the gang. David, Jay and Cal surprise him by making it their mission to get him a girl and help him lose his virginity.

After a heist in Venice, Steve turns on his partners in crime, killing safecracker John Bridger and keeping all the gold for himself; the rest of the team, including leader Charlie Croker, driver Handsome Rob, explosives man Left Ear and tech geek Lyle, vows revenge; they enlist the help of Bridger's daughter, Stella, and plot to recover the gold from Steve's Los Angeles mansion.

Doctor Louis Creed (Dale Midkiff) moves his family to Maine, where he meets a friendly local named Jud Crandall (Fred Gwynne). After the Creeds' cat is accidentally killed, Crandall advises Louis to bury it in the ground near the old pet cemetery. The cat returns to life, its personality changed for the worse. When Louis' son, Gage (Miko Hughes), dies tragically, Louis decides to bury the boy's body in the same ground despite the warnings of Crandall and Louis' visions of a deceased patient.

Beth (Lauren German), Lorna (Heather Matarazzo) and Whitney (Bijou Phillips), three young American women traveling abroad in Rome, decide to take a weekend excursion. Lured from their intended destination by a beautiful acquaintance (Vera Jordanova), the women anticipate a stay at a luxurious spa. Instead, they become pawns in a grisly game designed to entertain wealthy deviants from around the world.

Mathilda (Natalie Portman) is only 12 years old, but is already familiar with the dark side of life: her abusive father stores drugs for corrupt police officers, and her mother neglects her. Léon (Jean Reno), who lives down the hall, tends to his houseplants and works as a hired hitman for mobster Tony (Danny Aiello). When her family is murdered by crooked DEA agent Stansfield (Gary Oldman), Mathilda joins forces with a reluctant Léon to learn his deadly trade and avenge her family's deaths.

CASINO: In early-1970s Las Vegas, low-level mobster Sam "Ace" Rothstein (Robert De Niro) gets tapped by his bosses to head the Tangiers Casino. At first, he's a great success in the job, but over the years, problems with his loose-cannon enforcer Nicky Santoro (Joe Pesci), his ex-hustler wife Ginger (Sharon Stone), her con-artist ex Lester Diamond (James Woods) and a handful of corrupt politicians put Sam in ever-increasing danger. Martin Scorsese directs this adaptation of Nicholas Pileggi's book.

CARLITO'S WAY: A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

Prompted by her popular best friend to spill details of her boring weekend, Olive, a clean-cut teen, decides to spice things up by telling a little lie about losing her virginity; when the high-school busybody overhears the conversation and spreads it all over campus, Olive is suddenly notorious but for the wrong reasons.

Shallow, rich and socially successful Cher (Alicia Silverstone) is at the top of her Beverly Hills high school's pecking scale. Seeing herself as a matchmaker, Cher first coaxes two teachers into dating each other. Emboldened by her success, she decides to give hopelessly klutzy new student Tai (Brittany Murphy) a makeover. When Tai becomes more popular than she is, Cher realizes that her disapproving ex-stepbrother (Paul Rudd) was right about how misguided she was -- and falls for him.

A fresh, funny, real story about a group of gay men in Hollywood, their lovers and friends, and the often hilarious, occasionally poignant space in between -- that is if they can get any space at all. As they make their ways in the world with and without each other, they are suddenly faced with an unexpected tragedy. The group finds comfort the only way they ever have -- together.

In Vietnam in 1970, Captain Willard (Martin Sheen) takes a perilous and increasingly hallucinatory journey upriver to find and terminate Colonel Kurtz (Marlon Brando), a once-promising officer who has reportedly gone completely mad. In the company of a Navy patrol boat filled with street-smart kids, a surfing-obsessed Air Cavalry officer (Robert Duvall), and a crazed freelance photographer (Dennis Hopper), Willard travels further and further into the heart of darkness.

column2: The Girl Who Played With Fire
column3: Computer hacker Lisbeth Salander is accused of three murders while investigating a sex-trafficking ring with journalist Mikael Blomkvist. Lisbeth goes on the run while Mikael works to clear her name.

Two mischievous boys (James Freedson-Jackson, Hays Wellford) stumble upon a seemingly abandoned police cruiser and steal it, unaware that its murderous owner (Kevin Bacon) has stashed a hostage in the trunk.
An arms dealer confronts the morality of his work as he is being chased by an INTERPOL Agent.

column2: The Girl With The Dragon Tattoo
column3: Disgraced financial reporter Mikael Blomkvist (Daniel Craig) finds a chance to redeem his honor after being hired by wealthy Swedish industrialist Henrik Vanger (Christopher Plummer) to solve the 40-year-old murder of Vanger's niece, Harriet. Vanger believes that Harriet was killed by a member of his own family. Eventually joining Blomkvist on his dangerous quest for the truth is Lisbeth Salander (Rooney Mara), an unusual but ingenious investigator whose fragile trust is not easily won.

Basil embarks on the greatest case of his career when London's master toymaker is kidnapped. He ends up pitting his wits against his old adversary, Professor Ratigan, who wants to become 'supreme ruler of all mousedom'.

column2: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2
column3: His genius finally recognized by his idol Chester V, inventor Flint Lockwood gets to join Chester's company, where he can work full-time on technologies to help mankind. However, Flint soon discovers that his most-famous machine, which turns water into food, is still operating but now creates animal/vegetable hybrids. With the fate of humanity in Flint's hands, he and his friends set out to save the world from tacodiles, shrimpanzees and other deliciously dangerous creatures.

Abused kidnap victim Martin Bristol returns to his hometown 10 years after his abduction as a child and, warped by his experiences, begins a killing spree that authorities and his family race to stop.
Bank robbers (Brandon Johnson, Heather Magee) take two hostages to a rural farmhouse where a serial killer lurks.
Martin Bristol, a six-year-old, is abducted from his backyard swing and forced to witness the brutal crimes of a deranged madman.

Mafia flunky Joey Gazelle (Paul Walker) is ordered to dispose of the guns that killed a pair of policemen. He hides them in his basement, where they are found by Oleg (Cameron Bright), the kid from next door, who uses one to shoot his brutal stepfather, a Russian mobster. The boy runs off, and Joey pursues him into the criminal underworld, desperate to retrieve the incriminating weapon. Meanwhile, corrupt detective Rydell (Chazz Palminteri) is following Joey's trail with his own agenda.

column2: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hollows

column3: When their kingdom becomes trapped in perpetual winter, fearless Anna (Kristen Bell) joins forces with mountaineer Kristoff (Jonathan Groff) and his reindeer sidekick to find Anna's sister, Snow Queen Elsa (Idina Menzel), and break her icy spell. Although their epic journey leads them to encounters with mystical trolls, a comedic snowman (Josh Gad), harsh conditions, and magic at every turn, Anna and Kristoff bravely push onward in a race to save their kingdom from winter's cold grip.
A jewel thief asks a necrophiliac to help him retrieve a diamond from his dead partner's stomach.

Filmmaker Bing Liu returns to his hometown to document his friends’ daily lives. What he uncovers are revelations about where they’ve come from, apprehensions of who they’re becoming and a desire to course correct before it’s too late.

MINDING THE GAP is a Peabody Award winning, Oscar and Emmy nominated documentary which made The New York Times critic A.O. Scott’s top 10 films of the decade list.
A deranged projectionist shows a theatre full of zombies horror trailers from his collection.
Ten friends hire a limousine to take them to a party, only to be kidnapped, stripped and left for dead on the side of the road.
